description: Tengo 9 años me interesa la ciencia en especial la astrofísica y las matemáticas, considero que son importantes e interesantes para el conocimiento humano.
summary: My project is a multimedia story that tells the story of the Opportunity rover. This project will help me promote science so that kids my age get interested in space topics and take Oppy's resilient example.
details: My project is a multimedia story in which I tell, in a simple way but with NASA images, the story of the Opportunity rover. I used the Filmora app to add effects that make an impact on my audience, initially kids my age, to try to spark interest in space topics at an early age, and also why not take into account Oppy's resilient example.
dataRefs: Este mapa final de recorrido para el rover Opportunity de la NASA muestra dónde se encontraba el rover dentro de Perseverance Valley el 10 de junio de 2018, la última fecha en que contactó con su equipo de ingeniería.
